roadmap.title: Campaign playthrough
roadmap.description: Play the 13 story missions; most story, boss, kill-count and Slayer Gate unlocks come naturally. Take the first Slayer Gate and spend your first Sentinel Crystal.

roadmap.title: Campaign cleanup
roadmap.description: Finish upgrades, perks, Slayer Gates, collectible sets and weapon mods on the same save slot, then claim the Unmaykr.

roadmap.title: Special runs
roadmap.description: Do the Famine Mode run and a separate Extra Life Mode campaign.

roadmap.title: The Ancient Gods Part One
roadmap.description: Play the three Part One missions and finish their runes, secret encounters, Codex pages and Extra Life Mode run.

roadmap.title: The Ancient Gods Part Two
roadmap.description: Play the three Part Two missions, finish the Sentinel Hammer upgrades, Dark Lord boss, Codex pages and Extra Life Mode run.

roadmap.title: Horde Mode
roadmap.description: Beat the three Horde Mode missions.

roadmap.title: BATTLEMODE
roadmap.description: Play online matches for the demon and Slayer achievements; a private match with friends speeds it up.

achievements.description: Complete Hell on Earth.
achievements.summary: Complete the campaign mission Hell on Earth.

steps.text: Play through Mission 1, Hell on Earth, until it ends.

achievements.description: Kill the Doom Hunters.
achievements.summary: Kill all three Doom Hunters in Mission 4, Doom Hunter Base.

steps.text: Fight the Doom Hunters in @loc{Doom Hunter Base}. Shoot a Doom Hunter's shield with the @item{Plasma Rifle} to drop it, then finish it with the @item{Rocket Launcher} lock-on burst.

achievements.description: Blow a hole in Mars.
achievements.summary: Blow a hole in Mars during Mission 7, Mars Core.

steps.text: Play through Mission 7, Mars Core, until the story has you blast the hole.

achievements.description: Defeat the Gladiator in the Colosseum.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Gladiator boss in the Colosseum in Mission 8, Sentinel Prime.

steps.text: Beat the @enemy{Gladiator} in the Colosseum in Mission 8, Sentinel Prime.

achievements.description: Acquire a new Crucible in Taras Nabad.
achievements.summary: Acquire a new Crucible in Mission 9, Taras Nabad.

steps.text: Finish the story of Mission 9, Taras Nabad, to receive the new @item{Crucible}.

achievements.description: Kill the Khan Maykr.
achievements.summary: Kill the Khan Maykr in Mission 12, Urdak.

steps.text: Defeat the @enemy{Khan Maykr} at the end of Mission 12, Urdak.

achievements.description: Kill the Icon of Sin.
achievements.summary: Kill the Icon of Sin in Mission 13, Final Sin.

steps.text: Defeat the @enemy{Icon of Sin} in Mission 13, Final Sin.

achievements.description: Complete the Campaign on any difficulty
achievements.summary: Complete the campaign on any difficulty.

steps.text: Finish Mission 13, Final Sin, on any difficulty.

achievements.description: Beat all encounters and challenges and find all items in Taras Nabad in a single save slot.
achievements.summary: Clear every encounter and challenge and find every item in Mission 9, Taras Nabad, in one save slot.

guide.context: Mission 9 hides these pickups: 3 Doomtoys, 2 Albums, 3 Extra Lives, 3 Sentinel Batteries, 5 Praetor Suit Tokens, 2 Mastery Tokens, 7 Codex pages, an Automap, a Slayer Gate Key, a cheat code disk and a Sentinel Crystal.

steps.text: In @loc{Taras Nabad}, beat every encounter and every secret encounter, and finish the mission challenges.
Pick up all the items listed above.
If you missed any, use fast travel at the end of the mission or replay it on the same save slot.

achievements.description: Complete a Mission with only the Famine Mode cheat on
achievements.summary: Complete a mission with Famine Mode as the only active cheat.

guide.context: Famine Mode limits your ammo; you can only gain ammo from the chainsaw and from barrels.

steps.text: Find the Famine Mode cheat disk in Mission 10, Nekravol.
In the @loc{Fortress of Doom}, turn on the Famine Mode cheat and leave every other cheat off.
Replay a short mission such as Mission 1 and finish it. Do not use Extra Life Mode.

achievements.description: Complete Extra Life Mode with 10 Extra Lives in your Inventory
achievements.summary: Finish the campaign in Extra Life Mode with at least 10 Extra Lives in your inventory.

guide.context: You cannot replay missions in Extra Life Mode, so take every Extra Life on your first pass.

steps.text: Begin a fresh save in Extra Life Mode. Any difficulty works; the easiest is fine.
Pick up every Extra Life (green 1UP helmet) in each mission. You can still die; lives you already picked up still count.
Finish the campaign with 10 or more Extra Lives left.

achievements.description: Upgrade Health, Armor, or Ammo
achievements.summary: Upgrade Health, Armor, or Ammo.

steps.text: After Mission 1, spend your first Sentinel Crystal point on Health, Armor or Ammo in the @loc{Fortress of Doom}.

achievements.description: Fully upgrade Health, Armor, or Ammo in a single save slot
achievements.summary: Max out one of Health, Armor or Ammo upgrades in one save slot.

steps.text: Spend every Sentinel Crystal point on the same category, Health, Armor or Ammo, until it is maxed.

achievements.description: Complete a Praetor Suit Perk category in a single save slot
achievements.summary: Buy every perk in one Praetor Suit Perk category in one save slot.

steps.text: Earn Praetor Suit Points from mission challenges and secrets, and by feeding batteries to the rooms in the @loc{Fortress of Doom}.
Spend them on every perk of a single category.

achievements.description: Purchase all Praetor Suit Perks in a single save slot
achievements.summary: Buy all Praetor Suit Perks in one save slot.

steps.text: Keep collecting Praetor Suit Points and buy every perk.
Replay missions on the same save slot for any points you missed.

achievements.description: Spend 8 Sentinel Batteries in the Fortress of Doom in a single save slot
achievements.summary: Use 8 Sentinel Batteries on locked rooms in the Fortress of Doom in one save slot.

steps.text: Collect Sentinel Batteries in missions and as challenge rewards.
In the @loc{Fortress of Doom}, put batteries into the slots beside locked rooms until you have used 8.

achievements.description: Pick up 20 Extra Lives Total in a single save slot
achievements.summary: Pick up 20 Extra Lives in total in one save slot.

steps.text: Look for the green 1UP helmets while you play. You can lose them and they still count.
Replay missions on the same save slot for any you missed.

achievements.description: Complete the cheat code collection in a single save slot
achievements.summary: Collect every cheat code Floppy Disk in one save slot.

steps.text: Search every mission for hidden floppy disks (cheat codes).
Use fast travel at the end of missions or replay missions on the same save slot to pick up any you missed.

achievements.description: Complete the album collection in a single save slot
achievements.summary: Collect every vinyl album in one save slot.

steps.text: Search every mission for vinyl albums.
Use fast travel at the end of missions or replay missions on the same save slot to pick up any you missed.

achievements.description: Complete the toy collection in a single save slot
achievements.summary: Collect every Doomtoy in one save slot.

steps.text: Search every mission for Doomtoys. Many sit behind breakable walls.
Use fast travel at the end of missions or replay missions on the same save slot to pick up any you missed.

achievements.description: Collect all physical Codex pages in a single save slot
achievements.summary: Collect all 54 Codex pages in the campaign in one save slot.

guide.context: Codex pages look like burning paper floating in the air. Mission 8, Sentinel Prime, holds 9 of them.

steps.text: Collect the floating Codex pages in each mission.
Replay missions on the same save slot for any you missed.

achievements.description: Complete a Slayer Gate
achievements.summary: Complete a Slayer Gate.

guide.context: Do not use cheats, because the gate key does not appear.

steps.text: Find the Slayer Gate key in @loc{Exultia} (Mission 2). It is usually hidden close to the gate.
Open the gate with the key, activate the hive, and win the arena battle.

achievements.description: Complete all Slayer Gates in a single save slot
achievements.summary: Complete all six Slayer Gates in one save slot.

guide.context: Mars Core, Taras Nabad, Exultia, Cultist Base, Super Gore Nest and Arc Complex each have one gate.

steps.text: Find the key and win the gate arena in each of the six missions above.
You can finish the campaign first and come back when you are stronger.

achievements.description: Master all Weapon Mods in a single save slot
achievements.summary: Master all weapon mods in one save slot.

guide.context: This achievement is known to fail to unlock for some players. Avoid cheat codes while working on it.

steps.text: For each weapon, spend weapon points to fully upgrade both mods.
Finish the mastery challenge for each mod. Use a Mastery Token for any you struggle with.
Do not use cheat codes during this save.

achievements.description: Acquire the Unmaykr.
achievements.summary: Acquire the Unmaykr weapon in the Fortress of Doom.

guide.context: You need all six Slayer Gate keys first.

steps.text: Complete all six Slayer Gates and keep each reward key.
In the @loc{Fortress of Doom}, put all six keys into the device that holds the Unmaykr.

achievements.description: Perform 33 Unique Glory Kills in a single save slot
achievements.summary: Perform 33 unique Glory Kills in one save slot.

steps.text: Perform Glory Kills as you play. Vary the kills, because the 33 must be unique.

achievements.description: Play as 5 different Player Demons in BATTLEMODE
achievements.summary: Play as five different Player Demons in BATTLEMODE.

steps.text: Play BATTLEMODE matches as a demon. Pick a different demon each time until you have played five.

achievements.description: Do 5000 damage as a Player Demon in BATTLEMODE
achievements.summary: Deal a total of 5000 damage while playing a demon in BATTLEMODE.

steps.text: Play BATTLEMODE as a demon. Damage adds up across matches.

achievements.description: Kill 200 opponents in BATTLEMODE
achievements.summary: Kill 200 opponents in BATTLEMODE.

steps.text: Play BATTLEMODE matches and keep scoring kills.
Faster: set up a private match with three players. Have one demon stand still while you keep killing the other.

achievements.description: Play 25 BATTLEMODE matches
achievements.summary: Play 25 BATTLEMODE matches.

steps.text: Play 25 BATTLEMODE matches as either side.

achievements.description: Kill a Player Demon with each of the 8 Slayer weapons in BATTLEMODE
achievements.summary: In BATTLEMODE, get a kill on a Player Demon using every one of the eight Slayer weapons.

guide.context: A direct BFG-9000 hit does not count as a kill. If a mod kill fails to count, finish the demon with the weapon's normal left-click shot.

steps.text: Use each of these weapons to kill at least one Player Demon: Combat Shotgun, Heavy Cannon, Plasma Rifle, Rocket Launcher, Super Shotgun, Ballista, Chaingun, BFG-9000.
Weaken the demon first, then finish it with the weapon you need. You can spread this over many matches.
For the Combat Shotgun use the sticky bombs mod, for the Rocket Launcher use lock-on burst, for the Ballista use arbalest.
Choose the BFG-9000 as an upgrade during the match. Kill with its explosion, not a direct hit.

achievements.description: Heal yourself or your teammate for 50000 health in BATTLEMODE
achievements.summary: Heal yourself or your teammate for 50,000 health in BATTLEMODE.

steps.text: Play a demon and drop your healing zone on the floor.
Stand in it with your teammate. Wait for the cooldown and use it again; healing adds across matches.

achievements.description: Kill 666 Demons (excluding Player Demons and Wolves)
achievements.summary: Kill 666 demons, not counting Player Demons and wolves.

steps.text: Keep killing demons through the campaign until you reach 666.

achievements.description: Complete the UAC Atlantica Facility.
achievements.summary: Complete the UAC Atlantica Facility, the first mission of The Ancient Gods Part One.

steps.text: Play The Ancient Gods Part One, Mission 1, the UAC Atlantica Facility, to its end.

achievements.description: Destroy the Life Sphere in the Blood Swamps.
achievements.summary: Destroy the Life Sphere by completing The Blood Swamps in The Ancient Gods Part One.

steps.text: Finish The Ancient Gods Part One, Mission 2, The Blood Swamps.

achievements.description: Defeat Samur in the Holt.
achievements.summary: Defeat Samur in The Holt, the last mission of The Ancient Gods Part One.

steps.text: Finish The Ancient Gods Part One, Mission 3, The Holt, by defeating @enemy{Samur}.

achievements.description: Complete Extra Life Mode with 5 Extra Lives in your Inventory (Ancient Gods 1)
achievements.summary: Complete The Ancient Gods Part One in Extra Life Mode with at least 5 Extra Lives in your inventory.

guide.context: You cannot use the Extra Life rune in this mode.

steps.text: Start a new save in Extra Life Mode. Easy difficulty is fine.
Pick up the 1UP helmets in each mission and finish Part One with 5 or more lives left.

achievements.description: Acquire all Support Runes in a single save slot (Ancient Gods 1)
achievements.summary: Acquire all three Support Runes of The Ancient Gods Part One in one save slot.

steps.text: Mission 1 and Mission 3: complete the Slayer Gate to get the rune.
Mission 2: kill the giant tentacle at the start, jump over and go left. A breakable wall just beyond the flames hides the rune.

achievements.description: Complete all Secret Encounters in a single save slot (Ancient Gods 1)
achievements.summary: Complete all Secret Encounters of The Ancient Gods Part One in one save slot.

guide.context: Each of the three missions has two Secret Encounters.

steps.text: Find and win both Secret Encounters in each mission.
Replay a mission on the same save slot if you missed any.

achievements.description: Collect all physical Codex pages in a single save slot (Ancient Gods 1)
achievements.summary: Collect all Codex pages in The Ancient Gods Part One in one save slot.

steps.text: Collect the floating Codex pages in each Part One mission.
Replay missions on the same save slot for any you missed.

achievements.description: Complete World Spear.
achievements.summary: Complete The World Spear, the first mission of The Ancient Gods Part Two.

steps.text: Play The Ancient Gods Part Two, Mission 1, The World Spear, to its end.

achievements.description: Complete Reclaimed Earth.
achievements.summary: Complete Reclaimed Earth, the second mission of The Ancient Gods Part Two.

steps.text: Finish The Ancient Gods Part Two, Mission 2, Reclaimed Earth.

achievements.description: Complete Immora.
achievements.summary: Complete Immora, the third mission of The Ancient Gods Part Two.

steps.text: Finish The Ancient Gods Part Two, Mission 3, Immora.

achievements.description: Acquire all Sentinel Hammer upgrades (Ancient Gods 2)
achievements.summary: Acquire all Sentinel Hammer upgrades in The Ancient Gods Part Two.

steps.text: In each mission that has an escalation encounter, finish its first phase. The final boss mission has none.

achievements.description: Kill the Dark Lord.
achievements.summary: Kill the Dark Lord, the final boss of The Ancient Gods Part Two.

guide.context: The Super Shotgun is the only weapon you need. Keep the Sentinel Hammer charged by killing the dogs.

steps.text: Stay across the arena from the boss and kill zombies for health, armor and ammo. Do not shoot the boss yet.
Kill the dogs when they come to charge the @item{Sentinel Hammer}.
With the hammer full, move close to trigger his attack. When he glows green, do not dash. Shoot him to daze him, use the hammer to extend the daze, then fire 4 more @item{Super Shotgun} shots.
Dash away, restock from zombies, and repeat through all five phases.
From phase 2 he dashes at you: dash sideways twice. From phase 3 do not kill the Hell Knight, or a big group of enemies appears. In phase 4 kill the extra enemies. Phase 5 adds another dash.

achievements.description: Complete Extra Life Mode with 5 Extra Lives in your Inventory (Ancient Gods 2)
achievements.summary: Complete The Ancient Gods Part Two in Extra Life Mode with at least 5 Extra Lives in your inventory.

guide.context: You cannot use the Extra Life rune in this mode.

steps.text: Start a new save in Extra Life Mode.
Pick up the 1UP helmets in each mission and finish Part Two with 5 or more lives left.

achievements.description: Collect all physical Codex pages in a single save slot (Ancient Gods 2)
achievements.summary: Collect all Codex pages in The Ancient Gods Part Two in one save slot.

steps.text: Collect the floating Codex pages in each Part Two mission.
Replay missions on the same save slot for any you missed.

achievements.description: Complete the first Horde Mode Mission
achievements.summary: Complete the first Horde Mode mission.

steps.text: Start Horde Mode and finish the first mission, Cultist Base.

achievements.description: Re-collect all of the weapons on the Weapon Wheel
achievements.summary: Re-collect all weapons on the Weapon Wheel in Horde Mode.

guide.context: Your first loadout is the Chainsaw plus a Combat Shotgun with all mods mastered. Each cleared arena round randomly adds another gun with all mods mastered.

steps.text: Play through the Horde Mode arenas until your weapon wheel is full.

achievements.description: Beat Horde Mode
achievements.summary: Beat all three Horde Mode missions.

steps.text: Beat all three missions: Cultist Base, Reclaimed Earth, The Holt.
